title: Height and Setback in Subarea B3
previewText: In Subarea B3, as shown on Map 1 (Special Inwood District – Subdistricts and Subareas) in the Appendix to this Chapter, the maximum building height shall be 125 feet within 10 feet of a street line. Beyond 10 feet of a street line, the maximum building height shall be 265 feet.
